args: for root in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CANON_PLUGIN_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$PWD"; do [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/mcp-server/boot.sh" ] && exec bash "$root/mcp-server/boot.sh"; done; while IFS= read -r cand; do [ -f "$cand" ] && bash -n "$cand" 2>/dev/null && exec bash "$cand"; done < <(find "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache" -type f -name "boot.sh" -path "*/canon/[0-9]*/mcp-server/boot.sh" 2>/dev/null | sort -rV); echo "CANON FATAL: cannot locate mcp-server/boot.sh (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CANON_PLUGIN_DIR, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, PWD all miss; no plugin-cache fallback found)" >&2; exit 1
